title: Hellbender
hook: Player-safe note: The old Hellbender is the story people tell when the ground hears too much: an ancient spidermander presence said to sense movement through root, soil, and fear.

blocks.body: Being surrounded, misread as a monster, or driven toward Root's Hollow, Underroot, Spidermanders by noise and haste.
